Reminder resync pipeline (gather → plan → diff → schedule → cleanup)

Duplicated brand colour constants (#0B0F14 background, #F97316 primary)

Brand palette hard-coded in icon pixels, Tailwind tokens and PWA metadata
Native/PWA boundary enforcement (isNative gate + boundary test + dist check)

nodes.label: Data model & persistence
nodes.rationale: types.ts holds every interface (Id = number|string); Dexie GymDB (version 7) adds a sync middleware (UUID ids, updatedAt stamp, dirty flag) and onDataReplaced/emitDataReplaced for wholesale replaces; backup.ts TABLES is the serialization allow-list; merge.ts merges snapshots updatedAt-wins.

nodes.label: Invariant 8: additive Dexie schema + deterministic seed ids
nodes.norm_label: invariant 8: additive dexie schema + deterministic seed ids
nodes.rationale: Bump version(N) with only new stores and never edit a released version block; seed ids are deterministic (i+1) so two fresh installs merge without duplicating the catalog.

nodes.label: Invariant 6: equipment separation is by exerciseId
nodes.norm_label: invariant 6: equipment separation is by exerciseid
nodes.rationale: Variants are distinct exercises and there is no SetRow.equipment; every weight/PR/progression path already partitions by exerciseId.

nodes.label: build-deploy job
nodes.rationale: ubuntu-latest + Node 22 with npm cache: npm ci → npm run build → configure-pages → upload dist/ → deploy-pages. deploy-pages is continue-on-error and retried once after a 45s wait because the Pages service can be transiently unavailable. Only the build (tsc + vite) runs in CI — npm test is not executed.

nodes.label: Android toolchain (Node ≥ 22, JDK 21 with javac, SDK 36)
nodes.norm_label: android toolchain (node ≥ 22, jdk 21 with javac, sdk 36)
nodes.rationale: @capacitor/cli 8.5.2 needs Node ≥ 22 while the PWA still builds on Node 18+; the distro JRE lacks javac so Temurin 21 is used; env.sh sets ANDROID_HOME and PATH; a udev rule grants Samsung USB access.

nodes.label: VITE_USDA_KEY (USDA API key secret)
nodes.rationale: Optional repo secret for the full 1,000 req/hr USDA allowance; when unset the code falls back to DEMO_KEY (~30 req/hr/IP). Vite inlines VITE_* vars into the public bundle at build time, so .env/secrets only keep it out of git — acceptable solely because it is a free per-IP-rate-limited key.

nodes.label: Invariant 12: Env/CI rules (Node 18 floor / CI Node 22; Android Node ≥ 22 + JDK 21; exact Capacitor pins; no CDN)
nodes.norm_label: invariant 12: env/ci rules (node 18 floor / ci node 22; android node ≥ 22 + jdk 21; exact capacitor pins; no cdn)
nodes.rationale: The PWA builds on Node 18+, Android tooling needs Node ≥ 22 (@capacitor/cli 8.5.2) and JDK 21 with javac; Capacitor packages are pinned exactly so the committed android/ matches; workbox-build 7.1.1 override; zxing wasm and fonts are bundled; the USDA key is inlined only because it is a free per-IP-rate-limited key.

nodes.label: Invariant 10: HashRouter + parseRouteId; order by date, not id
nodes.norm_label: invariant 10: hashrouter + parserouteid; order by date, not id
nodes.rationale: Ids may be numbers or UUID strings, so route ids are parsed with parseRouteId (never Number()) and queries order by date/startedAt because UUIDs do not sort chronologically.

nodes.label: Static PWA on GitHub Pages (no backend)
nodes.norm_label: static pwa on github pages (no backend)
nodes.rationale: With no server, cross-device sync is a snapshot pushed to a private GitHub repo via the user's PAT and AI is Gemini free tier with a device-local BYO key; deploy = git push origin main → Actions → Pages. The same codebase also ships as a sideloaded Capacitor 8 Android app.

nodes.label: Workout logging (templates, supersets, one-tap sets, warm-ups, plate calculator)
nodes.norm_label: workout logging (templates, supersets, one-tap sets, warm-ups, plate calculator)
nodes.rationale: One-tap set logging is pre-filled from the last session; warm-up ramps and the plate calculator are barbell-only.

nodes.label: index.html — PWA entry document
nodes.rationale: Standalone web-app meta tags (apple-mobile-web-app-capable, mobile-web-app-capable, black-translucent status bar, viewport-fit=cover, theme-color #0B0F14) plus an apple-touch-icon make the page installable as a home-screen app; the #root div is mounted by /src/main.tsx.

nodes.label: PWA app icon (192x192 manifest icon)
nodes.rationale: 192x192 PNG declared in the VitePWA manifest.icons of vite.config.ts (type image/png, default purpose 'any'). Chrome/Android installability expects 192px and 512px PNG icons: this size is the home-screen/launcher icon, icon-512.png is the large/splash-size variant, maskable-512.png (purpose 'maskable') is the adaptive-icon variant with extra safe-zone padding, and apple-touch-icon.png (180px, linked from index.html) is the iOS home-screen counterpart. Matched by the Workbox precache glob (**/*.png) so it is available offline.

nodes.label: Orange dumbbell glyph (logo mark)
nodes.rationale: Flat, single-colour dumbbell silhouette: a short horizontal handle bar between two tall rounded plates, each flanked by a smaller outer plate, perfectly symmetric and centered (x 64-447, y 156-355 of 512, i.e. 75% of the canvas width and 39% of its height). Simple geometry and rounded corners keep it recognisable when downscaled to 192px/180px or cropped by an OS mask, and it signals the app's purpose (strength-training logging) without any text. The same dumbbell metaphor is reused in-app as the Workout tab icon.

nodes.label: GymTracker brand palette (#0B0F14 dark + #F97316 orange)
nodes.rationale: The icon uses exactly the app's own design tokens: background RGB(11,15,20) = #0B0F14 equals Tailwind colors.bg, the PWA manifest theme_color and background_color, and the index.html theme-color meta; glyph RGB(249,115,22) = #F97316 equals Tailwind colors.primary. The values are duplicated by hand in several places and baked into the PNG pixels rather than generated from one source, so changing the brand colour means editing all of them and regenerating the icons.

nodes.label: Orange dumbbell glyph (logo mark)
nodes.rationale: Flat single-colour, mirror-symmetric horizontal dumbbell built from rounded rectangles (thin handle bar, two tall inner plates, two shorter outer plates), no text, gradients or outlines. The dumbbell is the universal shorthand for strength training and matches the app purpose (workout, nutrition and ranking tracker); the simple shape stays legible at small launcher sizes (design intent inferred).

nodes.label: Build stamp (__APP_VERSION__, __BUILD_SHA__, __BUILD_TIME__)
nodes.rationale: vite.config.ts defines the app version from package.json, the build SHA from GITHUB_SHA or local git, and the build time; typed in vite-env.d.ts and shown by the Settings VersionFooter with the Dexie schema version and, on Android, versionName/versionCode.

nodes.label: Orange dumbbell glyph (bar with two plates per side)
nodes.norm_label: orange dumbbell glyph (bar with two plates per side)

nodes.label: icon-512.png (GymTracker app icon, 512x512)
nodes.rationale: Fully opaque 512x512 PNG: a full-bleed near-black square with a centered orange dumbbell, no baked-in rounded corners and no transparency, so each OS can apply its own icon mask. Declared with the default 'any' purpose in the VitePWA manifest (vite.config.ts manifest.icons, line 50); PWA installability guidance calls for 192px and 512px icons, so this is the large install/splash artwork. Sibling renditions of the same artwork: icon-192.png, maskable-512.png (glyph shrunk to 60% of the width to stay inside the Android safe zone) and apple-touch-icon.png (180px iOS home-screen icon, linked from index.html).

nodes.label: Icon palette (#0B0F14 dark + #F97316 orange)
nodes.rationale: Measured from pixels: about 80% of the canvas is #0B0F14 and the glyph is #F97316. #0B0F14 equals Tailwind 'bg' (tailwind.config.js L7), the PWA manifest theme_color/background_color (vite.config.ts L46-47) and <meta name='theme-color'> (index.html L10); #F97316 equals Tailwind 'primary' (orange-500, tailwind.config.js L14). Inferred rationale: the Home Screen tile matches the in-app dark theme and brand accent. The colours are baked into the PNG pixels of all four icon files, so changing those tokens means regenerating the icons by hand.

nodes.label: GymTracker brand palette (#0B0F14 near-black + #F97316 orange)
nodes.rationale: The icon reuses the app's exact theme colors: near-black #0B0F14 (Tailwind 'bg' token and manifest theme_color/background_color; fills about 80% of the pixels) and orange #F97316 (Tailwind 'primary' token; the dumbbell fill). Keeping icon, splash background, browser theme-color and in-app UI on one palette makes the installed app feel native. The colors are baked into raster pixels and no build script generates the icons (none exists in the repo), so changing the Tailwind tokens or manifest colors requires regenerating the PNG icons manually.

nodes.label: Brand palette: near-black #0B0F14 + orange #F97316
nodes.rationale: Two-colour, high-contrast scheme (about 6.9:1 contrast ratio). Near-black #0B0F14 fills about 83% of the pixels and equals the Tailwind token 'bg' (tailwind.config.js), the PWA manifest theme_color/background_color (vite.config.ts) and the theme-color meta tag in index.html; orange #F97316 (about 14% of pixels, Tailwind orange-500) equals the Tailwind token 'primary', which the TabBar also uses for the active tab. Reusing the in-app tokens makes the launcher icon, the PWA splash background and the UI read as one brand, but the values are duplicated literals rather than imports, so changing one means updating the others by hand.

nodes.label: Maskable safe-zone padding
nodes.rationale: Maskable icons are cropped by the OS to a circle, squircle or rounded square, so the artwork must be opaque and full-bleed with the important content inside the centred safe zone (circle of 80 percent of the icon diameter, 205 px radius at 512 px). Here the solid #0B0F14 background fills the whole 512x512 canvas (RGB, no alpha) and the dumbbell is scaled to 0.8x of the icon-512.png version (glyph width 308 px vs 385 px; farthest glyph pixel 160 px from centre vs 200 px), leaving a safe margin so no launcher mask clips it.

nodes.label: Food dedup gap: USDA branded search vs OFF (UPC-12 vs EAN-13)
nodes.norm_label: food dedup gap: usda branded search vs off (upc-12 vs ean-13)
nodes.rationale: Accepted low-severity limitation: the same product found via USDA branded search and via OFF can save as two rows when barcode formats differ; scoped out because the scan path already dedups via canonicalGtin.

nodes.label: Invariant 7: food dedup key offId = barcode ?? source:sourceId
nodes.norm_label: invariant 7: food dedup key offid = barcode ?? source:sourceid
nodes.rationale: OFF stays a bare EAN for backward compatibility, USDA branded reuses the EAN and whole foods use usda:<fdcId>.

nodes.label: JSON backup export/import
nodes.rationale: Deleting the app icon or wiping Safari website data also deletes IndexedDB, so export a backup (iOS share sheet) now and then.

nodes.label: GitHub snapshot sync (private repo via PAT)
nodes.norm_label: github snapshot sync (private repo via pat)
nodes.rationale: buildPayload serializes only TABLES; withSyncLock runs work on the sync chain without overlapping a pull; installSyncTriggers pushes dirty data on an 8 s debounce and its visibilitychange sync also covers Android resume.

nodes.label: Backup policy: allowBackup=false; GitHub Sync + JSON export
nodes.norm_label: backup policy: allowbackup=false; github sync + json export
nodes.rationale: Android cloud backup is off to keep the PAT and Gemini key out of Google Drive; storage.persist() is best effort and uninstalling deletes everything, so GitHub Sync and JSON export are the backups.

nodes.label: PWA → app data migration
nodes.rationale: The app's https://localhost storage is separate from the PWA's monniale.github.io origin, so it starts empty: finish workouts, sync and export in the PWA, then Connect GitHub Sync choosing 'Use cloud data (replace this device)' or import the JSON backup. Never 'Merge both' on a fresh install: freshly seeded settings and exercises would win and overwrite the real ones everywhere.

nodes.label: Capacitor 8 Android wrapper (same React codebase)
nodes.rationale: android/ + src/native/ wrap the unchanged React app for a sideloaded Samsung Galaxy S25 (One UI 8.5 / Android 16); the GitHub Pages PWA keeps deploying from main.

nodes.label: Native rest timer limitations
nodes.rationale: The 'Rest over' alert needs notifications allowed (in-app beep + vibration otherwise); a swiped countdown re-posts on resume because the end alarm is re-armed; the Live Update chip is unverified on One UI 8.5; exact timing relies on USE_EXACT_ALARM.

nodes.label: S25-like emulator AVD (360 CSS px)
nodes.rationale: 1080 px at 480 dpi = 360 CSS px, kept in the gitignored .android-test/, reproduces the Galaxy S25 viewport for the smoke test.

nodes.label: Sideload install on the Galaxy S25
nodes.norm_label: sideload install on the galaxy s25
nodes.rationale: Auto Blocker off, USB debugging on, adb install -r of the release APK (or install from My Files); Play Protect may ask for a scan. The app declares no SMS, accessibility or notification-listener permissions.

nodes.label: Versioning: versionName = package.json version, versionCode = git commit count
nodes.norm_label: versioning: versionname = package.json version, versioncode = git commit count
nodes.rationale: versionCode = git rev-list --count HEAD (override with GT_VERSION_CODE / -PgtVersionCode); an update needs a versionCode ≥ the installed one.

nodes.label: Native (Android / Capacitor) module group
nodes.rationale: All native code lives in src/native/ (plus Java plugins under android/) and is reachable only through isNative; the pure planner/prefs/store libs stay in src/lib/ so they are unit-testable.

nodes.label: ANDROID.md — Android runbook
nodes.rationale: Runbook for the Capacitor 8 build sideloaded on a Galaxy S25: toolchain, build, signing, install, data migration, updates, emulator smoke tests and known limitations.

nodes.label: Debug builds never use the real sync repo
nodes.norm_label: debug builds never use the real sync repo
nodes.rationale: A debug build is a separate app (….debug) but pushes test data to whatever repo it is connected to, so it uses a throwaway repo and PAT; smoke.sh aborts when the debug app is connected to gymtracker-data.

nodes.label: Live reload (debug builds only)
nodes.rationale: npx cap run android -l changes the WebView origin, so it is for debug builds only, and cap:sync must be re-run afterwards because a release build fails on a leftover server block.

nodes.label: Permanent identity: appId, https://localhost origin, release key
nodes.norm_label: permanent identity: appid, https://localhost origin, release key
nodes.rationale: appId io.github.monniale.gymtracker, origin https://localhost (no server block in capacitor.config.ts) and the release key are fixed: changing any of them means a new app with empty storage, so every workout on the phone is lost.

nodes.label: Guarded release build (release.sh)
nodes.rationale: The only way to build for the phone: refuses on uncommitted tracked files, a versionCode lower than the last release, or a synced live-reload server block / inspectable WebView; runs npm test, signs v2+v3+v4 and verifies with apksigner, zipalign -P 16 and aapt2. npx cap build android is banned (v1-only signatures rejected by targetSdk 36); an inspectable release exposes the PAT and Gemini key over USB.

nodes.label: Release signing key backup
nodes.rationale: gymtracker-release.jks + keystore.properties in ~/.android-keys/gymtracker/ must be backed up offline: without the same key an update cannot install and the only way out is an uninstall that deletes all phone data. .gitignore blocks *.jks, *.keystore and keystore.properties.

nodes.label: WebView text zoom pinned to 100%
nodes.rationale: The One UI font size does not apply inside the app, keeping the 360/320 px layouts intact.

nodes.label: Update flow (commit → release.sh → adb install -r)
nodes.rationale: Needs the same signing key and a versionCode ≥ the installed one; never uninstall, as that deletes all data.

nodes.label: Android guardrails (identity + debug-sync isolation)
nodes.rationale: Never change the appId, the WebView origin or the signing key, and never connect a debug build to the real sync repo; the full runbook is ANDROID.md.

nodes.label: Invariant 15: Android identity is permanent
nodes.rationale: appId io.github.monniale.gymtracker, WebView origin https://localhost (never set server/hostname/androidScheme) and the release key in ~/.android-keys/gymtracker/ never change, or the phone's data is orphaned or wiped; debug builds must never connect to the real sync repo.

nodes.label: Invariant 13: every screen fits 360px and 320px widths
nodes.norm_label: invariant 13: every screen fits 360px and 320px widths
nodes.rationale: Galaxy S25 is 360px wide: two+ NumberSteppers in a row use compact='narrow' + flex-wrap, chips get whitespace-nowrap/shrink-0, fixed widths in a row sum under ~290px; on Android setTextZoom(100) keeps these rules independent of the One UI font size.

nodes.label: Android shell: back button, keep-awake, haptics
nodes.norm_label: android shell: back button, keep-awake, haptics
nodes.rationale: NativeShell is a router companion: hardware back via the pure backAction plus the backStack LIFO of open sheets, pending notification-tap routes sanitized against ALLOWED_ROUTES, and keep-awake only while a session is active and on /workout/session or resting.

nodes.label: Native rest timer bridge
nodes.rationale: restTimerBridge syncs the zustand store rest state with the Java RestTimer plugin via pure reconcileDecision/bridgeAction, a serial queue and re-arm on resume; RestTimerController owns the exact end alarm, countdown and 'Rest over' notifications, and RestTimerReceiver handles Skip/+15 s with the process dead.

nodes.label: deploy.yml — Deploy to GitHub Pages workflow
nodes.norm_label: deploy.yml — deploy to github pages workflow
nodes.rationale: Runs on every push to main (plus manual workflow_dispatch), so deploying is just git push origin main. Least-privilege permissions (contents read, pages write, id-token write); concurrency group 'pages' cancels superseded runs.

nodes.label: Verification gate: npm run build + npm test
nodes.norm_label: verification gate: npm run build + npm test
nodes.rationale: npm run build = tsc --noEmit && vite build (typecheck + production bundle); npm test runs vitest. Deploy = git push origin main.

nodes.label: Adversarial review workflow
nodes.rationale: Both feature batches were adversarially reviewed by a workflow (task wfi2iqdh7, scripts review-past-workout-equipment-*.js) and confirmed findings were fixed most-severe first. Lesson: build the shared prompt CONTEXT with [...].join('\n') and never use backticks inside agent() prompt strings (template-literal parse error).

nodes.label: Past-workout calendar + editing
nodes.rationale: User choice: edits rescore the session and apply the rank delta so the score stays consistent with edited data, while achievements/quests only add, never revoke. Review fixes: dayFactor/streak are carried from the stored event (recomputing quartered the day's primary session — HIGH), the rank delta is atomic (re-read inside the transaction) with double-tap guards, a date move shifts every set's completedAt, and finish + rescore both bucket scoreEvent.date by startedAt. Edits write synced tables without withSyncTrackingSuspended because they are real user data.

nodes.label: Rescore rank drift (accepted limitation)
nodes.rationale: Editing an old session's e1RM/volume upward can leave a later session's PR bonus in place, so rank drifts above a from-scratch recompute (bounded by prBonusCap); the rank clamp at 0 can drift after a large downward edit. Fixing it would need a season-wide recompute subsystem, so it was accepted.

nodes.label: AI diet coach + macro-completion / food-swap
nodes.rationale: Diet report is generated manually and cached by date; 'complete your macros' suggestions offer tap-to-Add; EntryEditor offers an AI swap.

nodes.label: AI layer (Gemini free tier, device-local BYO key)
nodes.norm_label: ai layer (gemini free tier, device-local byo key)
nodes.rationale: Shared Gemini client built around generateStructured, aiStore holding key/model in localStorage, and the generic AiReportCard state machine.

nodes.label: AI workout coach + opening-weight suggestions
nodes.rationale: Post-workout coach note is auto-generated and cached by sessionId; pre-workout AI weights fire once per session via useWorkoutPlan with a silent offline fallback.

nodes.label: Task → files table
nodes.rationale: Maps each task area (schema, scoring, active workout, past workouts, equipment, diet, food DBs, AI, sync, charts, settings, Android shell, notifications, native rest timer, Android build) to the minimal file set to load.

nodes.label: CLAUDE.md — project instructions
nodes.rationale: Repo-scoped instructions auto-loaded every session: read ROUTEMAP first, check its invariants before schema/sync/scoring/AI changes, keep ROUTEMAP rows current, and follow ANDROID.md guardrails for the Capacitor build.

nodes.label: HANDOFF.md — food-DB providers, past-workout calendar, equipment variants
nodes.norm_label: handoff.md — food-db providers, past-workout calendar, equipment variants

nodes.label: ROUTEMAP.md — module index
nodes.rationale: Compact codebase map so a fresh chat loads only the files a task needs instead of scanning src/; line counts flag context cost.

nodes.label: Routemap-first context loading rule
nodes.rationale: src/ is ~18k lines across 116 files (incl. tests); scanning it blindly exhausts the context budget, so load only the files the Task → files table lists.

nodes.label: Double progression (auto-progression suggestions)
nodes.rationale: Rule-based next weight/rep suggestion; it is the offline baseline behind the AI opening-weight suggestions.

nodes.label: Invariant 2: AI cache writes use withSyncTrackingSuspended
nodes.norm_label: invariant 2: ai cache writes use withsynctrackingsuspended
nodes.rationale: AI cache rows use natural keys (not in UUID_TABLES) and must not mark data dirty; real user-data writes must not be suspended.

nodes.label: Invariant 3: secrets and device-local prefs never touch Dexie
nodes.norm_label: invariant 3: secrets and device-local prefs never touch dexie
nodes.rationale: The Gemini key, the GitHub PAT and device-local prefs (notifications, haptics, rest-alert mode) live in zustand-persist localStorage stores (gymtracker-ai, gymtracker-sync, gymtracker-notify), so they are never synced or backed up.

nodes.label: Invariant 1: backup.ts TABLES is the sync allow-list
nodes.norm_label: invariant 1: backup.ts tables is the sync allow-list
nodes.rationale: A table syncs iff it is listed in TABLES (mirrored in merge.ts SnapshotTables); device-local AI caches (coachNotes, dietNotes, workoutSuggestions, dietSuggestions) are deliberately excluded.

nodes.label: ROUTEMAP Invariants (cross-cutting rules)
nodes.rationale: 18 rules to read before any schema, sync, scoring or AI change; 14–18 cover the Android/Capacitor build.

nodes.label: ROUTEMAP maintenance rule (one line per module)
nodes.norm_label: routemap maintenance rule (one line per module)
nodes.rationale: Adding, renaming or removing a module, or changing an invariant, must update the matching row and the Task→files table; a subsystem past ~8 files gets its own section.

nodes.label: One UI notification setup
nodes.rationale: Allow notifications, Battery → Unrestricted, add GymTracker to Never sleeping apps, optionally Live notifications, then test with the phone locked via Test rest (15 s) and Send test reminder (15 s).

nodes.label: Diet & nutrition subsystem
nodes.rationale: nutrition.ts logFood is the single write path; foodProviders.ts orchestrates OFF + USDA search and the barcode chain; BarcodeScanSheet uses ML Kit on Android with a zxing fallback.

nodes.label: USDA energy nutrient fallback (208 → 957 → 958 → kJ 268)
nodes.rationale: Foundation foods report energy under Atwater nutrients 957/958, not 208 (verified against the live API), so using 208 alone silently dropped every whole food. Try 208 → 957 → 958 → kJ 268/4.184, filtering unitName==='KCAL'.

nodes.label: Equipment variants (equipment on Exercise)
nodes.rationale: Variants-as-exercises separate weight data for free because all analytics key by exerciseId, carry zero risk to the scoring engine and match the seed catalog's existing variant exercises. Per-set SetRow.equipment was rejected: it would touch every weight/PR/progression/chart/briefing path and need a new index plus backfill. Switching gear means picking a different variant.

nodes.label: Workout subsystem
nodes.rationale: Live session logging, templates, past-workout calendar/editing, double progression, plates, scoring, season lifecycle and strength standards.

nodes.label: Invariant 9: propagating deletes use tombstones
nodes.rationale: Deletes that must reach other devices use deleteWithTombstone/tombstoneKeys; device-local cache deletes use a plain suspended delete().

nodes.label: Nothing runs while the app is closed
nodes.norm_label: nothing runs while the app is closed
nodes.rationale: Sync, daily rank checks and re-planning happen only on open/resume; only already-scheduled alarms and rest-timer actions fire, and notification taps only navigate, never write data.

nodes.label: Rolling reminder horizon vs Samsung sleeping apps
nodes.norm_label: rolling reminder horizon vs samsung sleeping apps
nodes.rationale: One UI sleeps apps unused ~3 days (alarms restricted) and deep-sleeps them after ~16, so reminders are planned only a few days ahead (7 days; water 2; one recap) with an 'Open GymTracker to keep your reminders coming' notice on the last planned day; after a reboot reminders re-arm only after the first unlock.

nodes.label: Multi-provider food databases (OFF + USDA)
nodes.rationale: Both providers are free and CORS-open (USDA verified access-control-allow-origin: *) and USDA complements OFF on whole foods; Nutritionix/Edamam/FatSecret were rejected because they need secret keys/OAuth, which is wrong for a no-backend app. Pluggable FoodProvider registry with zero Dexie migration thanks to the derived offId dedup key.

nodes.label: USDA FoodData Central (FDC)
nodes.rationale: Free external food API that complements OFF on whole foods. Branded values are per-100g, barcodes are stored as UPC-12/GTIN-14, and Foundation foods report energy under Atwater nutrients 957/958 rather than 208.

nodes.label: anyOk error semantics (throw only if every provider fails)
nodes.norm_label: anyok error semantics (throw only if every provider fails)
nodes.rationale: safeSearch swallowing all errors made a real outage show 'No results' instead of 'unreachable'; searchAcross/lookupAcross now track anyOk and rethrow only when EVERY provider errored.

nodes.label: GTIN canonicalization (strip leading zeros)
nodes.rationale: FDC stores UPC-12/GTIN-14 while the zxing scanner yields EAN-13, so an exact-string gtin compare never matched; canonicalGtin strips leading zeros on both sides.

nodes.label: Search fallback / barcode chain strategy
nodes.rationale: User choice: text search queries OFF first and USDA only when OFF is thin (<5 results); barcode lookup tries OFF then USDA and the first hit wins.

nodes.label: Android reminder engine (notifications)
nodes.rationale: Pure notifyPlanner plans one-shot reminders from a single read-only gatherPlannerData transaction; notifications.ts resyncNow (plan → diff/full → schedule → shade cleanup) runs through a debounced single-flight requestResync; prefs live in the gymtracker-notify zustand store.

nodes.label: Invariant 17: notification channels are immutable (_vN ids)
nodes.norm_label: invariant 17: notification channels are immutable (_vn ids)
nodes.rationale: Android channels cannot change sound/importance/vibration after creation, so the id is bumped and the old one deleted (OBSOLETE_CHANNELS for reminders, RestTimerController.ensureChannels for rest), updating the ids mirrored in notifyHealth.ts and smoke.sh.

nodes.label: Vitest unit-test suite (~326 tests)
nodes.rationale: Tests sit next to their module, run in vitest's node environment without jsdom and with TZ=Europe/Rome; pure functions plus fake-indexeddb; nativeBoundary.test enforces invariant 14.

nodes.label: Evidence-based workout score
nodes.rationale: Volume load ÷ bodyweight weighted by relative intensity (% of Epley-estimated 1RM), plus PR bonuses for progressive overload, a weekly-consistency streak multiplier, junk-volume caps and idle decay.

nodes.label: ML Kit scanner with zxing fallback
nodes.norm_label: ml kit scanner with zxing fallback
nodes.rationale: ML Kit downloads its scanner module through Play services on first use; if that fails, the zxing camera fallback and manual entry remain.

nodes.label: Camera barcode scanner (zxing WASM)
nodes.rationale: zxing WASM is bundled (no CDN) and yields EAN-13 codes; manual entry is the fallback.

nodes.label: Diet tracking (meal log, training/rest-day macro targets, recipes, water)
nodes.norm_label: diet tracking (meal log, training/rest-day macro targets, recipes, water)
nodes.rationale: Your macro overrides always win over database values, online search results are cached locally for offline reuse, and recipes are cooked once then logged per portion.

nodes.label: Open Food Facts (OFF)
nodes.rationale: Free, CORS-open food database used for text search and barcode lookup, with results cached locally for offline reuse; OFF rows keep the bare EAN as offId, which keeps the dedup key backward-compatible.

nodes.label: Offline-first, all data on device (IndexedDB)
nodes.rationale: Single-user PWA installed from Safari that runs fully offline and keeps all data on the phone. The README still says Open Food Facts search is the only network call — outdated now that USDA FDC, Gemini AI and opt-in GitHub snapshot sync exist.

nodes.label: Dual build outputs: dist/ (Pages PWA) vs dist-android/
nodes.norm_label: dual build outputs: dist/ (pages pwa) vs dist-android/
nodes.rationale: npm run build produces the Pages PWA (base /GymTracker/, service worker) checked by check-pwa-dist.mjs; build:android produces dist-android/ with base ./ and no service worker or manifest; cap:sync copies it into android assets.

nodes.label: Emulator smoke test (checks 1–10)
nodes.rationale: smoke.sh reinstalls the debug APK and checks cold launch, origin/platform/no SW, 360/320 px layout + font scale, insets, channels, exact alarms, rest timer fg/bg, process death, reminders planned/fired/tap-routed and the back button; cdp-eval.mjs evaluates JS in the debug WebView.

nodes.label: GitHub Pages (static hosting)
nodes.rationale: Hosts the no-backend PWA under the /GymTracker/ base path (live at https://monniale.github.io/GymTracker/); the repo's Pages source must be set to GitHub Actions.

nodes.label: Alternative deploy (gh-pages branch / Netlify Drop)
nodes.rationale: Without CI: npm run deploy publishes to the gh-pages branch, or build with BASE_PATH=/ and drag dist/ onto Netlify Drop.

nodes.label: iPhone install via Safari Add to Home Screen
nodes.norm_label: iphone install via safari add to home screen
nodes.rationale: Launching from the home-screen icon gives a standalone, offline-capable app whose data stays on the phone.

nodes.label: iOS PWA limits
nodes.rationale: Imposed by iOS: the timer beep only plays while the app is on screen, there is no vibration API and no push-free local notifications, and IndexedDB is wiped along with the icon or Safari website data.

nodes.label: Progress tracking (e1RM/volume charts, muscle volume, PR wall, strength standards)
nodes.norm_label: progress tracking (e1rm/volume charts, muscle volume, pr wall, strength standards)
nodes.rationale: Weekly sets per muscle are compared with the 10–20 set evidence band; the PR wall shows strength-standard levels from Novice to Elite.

nodes.label: iOS Home Screen icon (apple-touch-icon)
nodes.rationale: Facts: README's iPhone install flow is Safari > Share > Add to Home Screen > 'Launch from the icon'; index.html L11 has <link rel='apple-touch-icon' href='./apple-touch-icon.png'>; vite.config.ts L34 lists it in vite-plugin-pwa includeAssets; it is NOT in the manifest icons (those are icons/icon-192, icon-512 and maskable-512, for Android/Chromium installs). Inferred rationale: iOS Safari takes the Home Screen tile from the apple-touch-icon link, so a dedicated 180x180 opaque full-bleed PNG is shipped (iOS applies its own rounded-corner mask, hence no baked-in corners and no alpha channel).

nodes.label: Pages base path must match repo name (/GymTracker/)
nodes.norm_label: pages base path must match repo name (/gymtracker/)
nodes.rationale: GitHub Pages serves the app at https://<user>.github.io/GymTracker/, so the repo name must match the base path in vite.config.ts (change it there for a different name).

nodes.label: Invariant 5: finishSession is non-idempotent — re-score with rescoreSession
nodes.norm_label: invariant 5: finishsession is non-idempotent — re-score with rescoresession
nodes.rationale: finishSession adds a scoreEvent, full points and bumps the streak; rescoreSession updates the existing event, applies only the points delta and carries the streak.

nodes.label: Invariant 18: LocalNotifications discipline
nodes.rationale: Only one-shot schedule.at with allowWhileIdle and an explicit isExactNotification; never repeating schedules, never schedule() without granted+enabled notifications, never a time ≤ now + 30 s (LEAD_MS), never cancel with an empty list; taps only navigate to whitelisted routes and never write data or call finishSession.

nodes.label: Invariant 16: notification id scheme
nodes.rationale: LocalNotifications ids = cat*10_000_000 + dayIdx*100 + slot (dayIdx from 2026-01-01), planner cats 10–18, 99 = test; RestTimer owns ids 4201/4202 and request codes 4211–4215 outside LN; never removeAllDeliveredNotifications() because it also kills the rest countdown.

nodes.label: App shell & routing
nodes.rationale: main.tsx mounts App (Android: initNativeEarly before the first render); App.tsx owns the HashRouter and all routes and on launch runs ensureSeeded, runDailyChecksOnce, catch-up achievements/quests and sync, plus a gated initNative + lazy NativeShell on Android. routes.ts TAB_ROUTES/KNOWN_ROUTES are shared by TabBar, the back handler and deep links.

nodes.label: Semi-manual checks (11–16 + on-device)
nodes.rationale: Shade +15 s/Skip, keep-awake on /workout/session, export share sheet, import + re-plan, update/reboot keeping data and re-arming reminders, Doze firing; on the S25: ML Kit scanner, Live Update chip, edge-to-edge insets and the rest alert on earbuds/vibrate.

nodes.label: Rainbow-Six-style ranking (Copper III → Champion)
nodes.rationale: Gamification on top of the score: 12-week seasons with recap and a ghost race against the previous season, idle decay, deterministic weekly quests (+15 pts), achievements and PR confetti.

nodes.label: Gamification & progress modules
nodes.rationale: Achievements and weekly quests are add-only; ProgressScreen shows e1RM trends, PR wall and muscle volume with self-hosted SVG chart primitives (no CDN).

nodes.label: Invariant 11: report mode (?report=1) skips side-effects
nodes.rationale: Viewing an old session must skip checkAchievements, evaluateQuests, confetti and rank-up.

nodes.label: Invariant 4: thinkingBudget=0 on every structured Gemini call
nodes.norm_label: invariant 4: thinkingbudget=0 on every structured gemini call
nodes.rationale: Gemini Flash otherwise truncates the JSON output; new generators go through generateStructured<T>.

nodes.label: Rest timer (auto-start, timestamp-based, wake lock)
nodes.rationale: Timestamp-based so it survives backgrounding/relaunch; short 30s rest after warm-ups and held until the last superset member; the screen wake lock exists because iOS only plays the beep while the app is on screen.

nodes.label: Invariant 14: Native/PWA split (plugins only in src/native/)
nodes.norm_label: invariant 14: native/pwa split (plugins only in src/native/)
nodes.rationale: Outside src/native/ code may statically import only platform.ts and haptics.ts; everything else is a dynamic import()/React.lazy gated on isNative, which is compile-time false in the Pages build so Rollup drops the native chunks. Enforced by nativeBoundary.test.ts and check-pwa-dist.mjs; dist-android/ is never deployed.

hyperedges.label: FoodProvider registry: OFF + USDA search / barcode / upsert flow
Past-workout calendar → edit → rescore flow
PWA app icon set (manifest icons + iOS touch icon)
PWA install icon set declared in the VitePWA config
Reminder resync pipeline (gather → plan → diff → schedule → cleanup)
Phone data-loss guards (identity, signing key, no-uninstall updates, debug isolation, migration)
Duplicated brand colour constants (#0B0F14 background, #F97316 primary)
GymTracker app icon set (same barbell artwork for iOS and PWA manifest)
Brand palette duplicated across icon pixels, PWA manifest and Tailwind theme
Brand palette hard-coded in icon pixels, Tailwind tokens and PWA metadata
Native/PWA boundary enforcement (isNative gate + boundary test + dist check)
